scope: Task-scoped advice inventory, preserved global document/advice gates, metadata-only canonical task repair, public CPU regression/serialized size checks; no model/token/latency/deployment or SGLang claim

implementation.procedure: Review actual patch/consumer routes and docs
implementation.acceptance: Only node advice inventory shrinks; global inventory/coverage, all guides, scoped adopted hashes retain

reference_boundary.procedure: Compare frozen baseline and adversarial CPU fixtures
reference_boundary.acceptance: Adopt/adapt/no advice/multi-task overlap plus stale guide/advice/legacy shape fail closed

data_integrity.acceptance: Hashes resolve; original malformed detail other bytes remain unchanged; raw and failures preserved

numerical_sanity.acceptance: Same UTF-8/minimal JSON settings; no character to token conversion or hidden workload change

measurement_validity.acceptance: Serialized representation only; no live tokenizer/model or end-to-end saving claim

reproducibility.acceptance: Fixtures and relevant/full/reader tests succeed; unrelated existing stale generated ref disclosed
